[[Melandru's Grip]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped by [[Acolyte of Melandru]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Marga Coast]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Poison]] duration on foes by 33% (stacking)
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +7 vs. [[Elemental damage]]
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Briarwood Scythe]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Briarwood Scythe]] from collectors [[Fopp]] or [[Pathfinder Mia]] 
*[[Poisonous]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Warding]]
